statement: The dormant constant-size page planner admits brick-aligned signed-grid windows with a 4096 metre maximum stride and an explicit cap of at most 1024 pages. Indexed windows clip outer bounds and retain stable interiors during extension. Exact ordered acknowledgements reject skipped, duplicate, reordered, overlapping, shortened or identity-mismatched requests. Single-page admission bounds canonical candidate and sample work, contiguous buffers and mesher cache entry counts including normal halos before callbacks or allocation. Map-node bytes remain subject to the charged APIs. Only tests call the planner; explicit-span facade regressions are indexed separately. Production ownership and native execution remain pending.
